metadata.description: 38 self-contained ML/AI Agent Skills, packaged as one all-in-one plugin and one plugin per domain.

plugins.name: ml-ai-skills
plugins.description: All 38 ML/AI Agent Skills from the ml-ai-skills library, covering Foundations, Classical ML, Deep Learning, LLM, Specialized, MLOps, Responsible AI, Security.

plugins.name: foundations
plugins.description: 4 Foundations Agent Skill(s) from the ml-ai-skills library: ml-math-essentials, ml-problem-framing, python-for-ml, statistics-for-ml.

plugins.name: classical-ml
plugins.description: 6 Classical ML Agent Skill(s) from the ml-ai-skills library: data-preprocessing, feature-engineering, hyperparameter-tuning, model-evaluation, supervised-learning, unsupervised-learning.

plugins.name: deep-learning
plugins.description: 6 Deep Learning Agent Skill(s) from the ml-ai-skills library: attention-mechanisms, cnn-vision, neural-net-fundamentals, pytorch-patterns, rnn-sequence, training-deep-models.

plugins.name: llm
plugins.description: 7 LLM Agent Skill(s) from the ml-ai-skills library: agent-evaluation, agents-and-tools, fine-tuning-llms, llm-evaluation, prompt-engineering, rag-evaluation, rag-pipeline.

plugins.name: specialized
plugins.description: 5 Specialized Agent Skill(s) from the ml-ai-skills library: computer-vision, nlp-tasks, recommender-systems, reinforcement-learning, time-series.

plugins.name: mlops
plugins.description: 6 MLOps Agent Skill(s) from the ml-ai-skills library: ci-cd-for-ml, data-pipelines, experiment-tracking, ml-monitoring, model-deployment, model-optimization.

plugins.name: responsible-ai
plugins.description: 3 Responsible AI Agent Skill(s) from the ml-ai-skills library: ai-ethics-fairness, data-privacy, explainability.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: 1 Security Agent Skill(s) from the ml-ai-skills library: ai-ml-security.
